lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone adult comedy episode in a Russian garage co-op: an old mechanic rates a bad used car with heavy swearing, then goes silent at a good car from the bot. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 proud, bragging about a bargain; 2 defensive, offended; 3 lost, quiet but clear; 4 urgent, decisive.

gav.profile: Gavrilych — an old Russian garage mechanic in his 60s, forty years under cars, gruff husky voice, red-faced, swears a lot but in a funny, natural, folksy way. Adult street comedy, uncensored.
gav.notes: Pronounce every swear word fully, clearly and naturally — do not soften, skip or bleep them. Lines 1–4: growing outrage, loud and juicy; line 5: stunned, quiet, almost tender deadpan after a pause.

san.profile: Sanych — an elderly neighbour in the garage co-op, retired, grows seedlings, fussy, high nervous voice.
san.notes: Line 1: annoyed, shouting across the yard; line 2: amazed, joyful.

stas.profile: Stas — a calm, confident young Russian used-car flipper in his 30s, a bit cheeky.
